works.title: Pattern-Oriented Software Architecture Vol. 2: Patterns for Concurrent and Networked Objects
works.note: Names and specifies the canonical synchronization-pattern set of this route: Double-Checked Locking Optimization, Monitor Object, Scoped Locking, Strategized Locking, Thread-Safe Interface.

works.title: Pattern-Oriented Software Architecture Vol. 3: Patterns for Resource Management
works.note: Names the Coordinator pattern for atomic multi-participant resource operations.

works.title: Design Patterns for Embedded Systems in C: An Embedded Software Engineering Toolkit
works.note: Embedded-C synchronization/deadlock-avoidance pattern set: Critical Region (interrupt-masking realization), Guarded Call, Ordered Locking, Simultaneous Locking, Rendezvous.

works.title: Real-Time Design Patterns; Doing Hard Time; Real-Time UML
works.note: Real-Time Design Patterns catalogs the priority-inversion countermeasures as design patterns (Priority Inheritance, Priority Ceiling / Highest Locker).

works.title: Mastering the FreeRTOS Real-Time Kernel
works.note: Canonical RTOS-side teaching of task-level synchronization primitives: direct-to-task notifications, event groups, semaphores/mutexes, critical sections via interrupt masking.

works.title: An Embedded Software Primer
works.note: Names interrupt-masking critical sections and teaches semaphore discipline in the RTOS/interrupt context (shared-data problem).

works.title: What Every Programmer Should Know About Memory
works.note: Hardware-grounded treatment of memory ordering, fences, and atomic read-modify-write (CAS) costs underlying every lock-free element in this route.

works.title: The Art of Multiprocessor Programming, 2nd ed.
works.authors: Maurice Herlihy, Nir Shavit, Victor Luchangco, Michael Spear
works.note: The theory anchor of shared-memory synchronization (1st ed. 2008): spin locks and TTAS, queue locks incl. MCS, monitors/condition variables, semaphores, readers-writers, stamped (tagged) references for ABA, CAS retry loops, STM. Publisher page loaded live (Elsevier, 2nd ed. 2020).

works.title: Is Parallel Programming Hard, And, If So, What Can You Do About It?
works.note: The practice anchor for kernel-grade synchronization: locking, deferred processing (RCU, sequence locks), and the memory-ordering chapter covering acquire/release and barriers. Living book, v2026.06.21a confirmed live.

works.title: Java Concurrency in Practice
works.authors: Brian Goetz, Tim Peierls, Joshua Bloch, Joseph Bowbeer, David Holmes, Doug Lea
works.note: Names and teaches the managed-runtime synchronization idioms of this route: latches, lock striping, reentrant locks, safe publication, thread confinement, condition queues, and the definitive DCL analysis. Publisher (InformIT) page loaded live.

works.title: Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture
works.authors: Martin Fowler with Rice, Foemmel, Hieatt, Mee, Stafford
works.note: Names the offline-concurrency lock family: Optimistic/Pessimistic Offline Lock, Coarse-Grained Lock, Implicit Lock. martinfowler.com book page loaded live.

works.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
works.note: Best modern treatment of the database/distributed synchronization elements: names fencing tokens; teaches snapshot isolation, MVCC, two-phase locking, and Lamport timestamps. Official site (dataintensive.net) loaded live incl. ISBN.

works.title: Transaction Processing: Concepts and Techniques
works.note: The catalog-grade treatment of database lock engineering: two-phase locking, multi-granularity locking, lock escalation, deadlock detection, optimistic schemes. Elsevier product page loaded live.

works.title: The Linux Programming Interface
works.note: Names the self-pipe trick (sec. 63.5.2) and teaches POSIX-level condition variables and semaphores. Author's official page (man7.org/tlpi) loaded live.

works.title: Linux kernel locking, RCU and memory-barrier documentation
works.authors: Linux kernel community (David Howells, Paul E. McKenney, Will Deacon, Peter Zijlstra et al.)
works.note: Official living documentation naming/teaching seqlocks, spinlock discipline, PI-futexes and rt-mutex priority inheritance, RCU (whatisRCU), and the memory-barriers.txt taxonomy of barrier kinds. locking/ index, memory-barriers.txt, and RCU/whatisRCU all loaded live.

works.title: Futexes Are Tricky
works.note: The canonical user-level treatment of futex-based synchronization construction. Primary PDF loaded live (title page: Nov 5, 2011).

works.title: Preshing on Programming (lock-free and memory-ordering series)
works.note: Names acquire-release ordering as a programmer-facing concept (2012 post loaded live) and gives the standard accessible treatments of memory barriers and C++11 double-checked locking.

works.title: Algorithms for Scalable Synchronization on Shared-Memory Multiprocessors
works.authors: John M. Mellor-Crummey, Michael L. Scott
works.note: Names the MCS queue lock and is the canonical comparative treatment of spinning: test-and-test-and-set, ticket locks, queue locks. Crossref DOI metadata confirmed live.

works.title: On Optimistic Methods for Concurrency Control
works.authors: H. T. Kung, John T. Robinson
works.note: Names optimistic concurrency control (read/validate/write phases). ACM DL page title confirmed live.

works.title: Concurrency Control in Distributed Database Systems
works.note: The classic survey framing two-phase locking and timestamp-ordering concurrency control, including distributed deadlock detection. Crossref DOI metadata confirmed live.

works.title: Priority Inheritance Protocols: An Approach to Real-Time Synchronization
works.authors: Lui Sha, Ragunathan Rajkumar, John P. Lehoczky
works.note: Names both the priority inheritance and priority ceiling protocols, with the schedulability analysis. Crossref DOI metadata confirmed live.

works.title: Monitors: An Operating System Structuring Concept
works.note: Names the monitor and its condition variables (wait/signal). Crossref DOI metadata confirmed live.

works.title: Cooperating Sequential Processes (EWD123)
works.venue: EWD archive, University of Texas at Austin (published in Programming Languages, 1968)
works.note: Names semaphores (P/V) and solves the critical-section mutual-exclusion problem. UT Austin EWD archive transcription loaded live confirming both.

works.title: Time, Clocks, and the Ordering of Events in a Distributed System
works.note: Names logical clocks and the happened-before ordering. Author's official publications page loaded live confirming venue/year.

works.title: Synchronization with Eventcounts and Sequencers
works.authors: David P. Reed, Rajendra K. Kanodia
works.note: Names the eventcount (and sequencer) primitive; still the canonical source, echoed in modern lock-free queue designs. Crossref DOI metadata confirmed live.

works.title: Software Transactional Memory
works.venue: PODC '95 (14th ACM Symposium on Principles of Distributed Computing)
works.note: Names software transactional memory (Dijkstra Prize 2012); AMP ch. 18 is the textbook companion. Crossref DOI metadata confirmed live.

works.title: Flat Combining and the Synchronization-Parallelism Tradeoff
works.authors: Danny Hendler, Itai Incze, Nir Shavit, Moran Tzafrir
works.venue: SPAA '10 (22nd ACM Symposium on Parallelism in Algorithms and Architectures)
works.note: Names flat combining; sole catalog-grade source for the element. Crossref DOI metadata and Shavit's MIT publications page both loaded live.

works.title: Concurrency Control in Groupware Systems
works.authors: C. A. Ellis, S. J. Gibbs
works.note: Names operational transformation (dOPT) for collaborative editing; the canonical OT source. Crossref DOI metadata confirmed live.

works.title: Patterns in Java, Volume 1: A Catalog of Reusable Design Patterns Illustrated with UML
works.note: Names the Balking and Guarded Suspension concurrency patterns (7-pattern concurrency chapter). Wiley legacy catalog page loaded live (title, author, ISBN, 1998).

works.title: HotSpot Glossary of Terms
works.note: Official OpenJDK definition of safepoint (GC-root-consistent stopping points); page loaded live this session with the safepoint entry confirmed. Mechanism analysis: Agesen, Sun Labs TR SMLI TR-98-70.

notes: All 57 r5 elements covered by >=1 catalog-grade work; no gaps. 7 memberships (posa2, posa3, douglasspatternsc, douglassrtcorpus, freertosbook, dsimonprimer, dreppermem) + 23 new works, all verified against live primary pages (publisher pages, author pages, kernel.org, openjdk.org via UA-fetch, UT Austin EWD archive, ACM DL title, Crossref DOI registry for 8 paper DOIs). Deliberate economy calls: Anderson 1990 (spinlock), Courtois et al. 1971 (readers-writer), Franke et al. 2002 (futex), Eswaran et al. 1976 (2PL), Berenson et al. 1995 (snapshot isolation), Bernstein & Goodman 1983 (MVCC) omitted as single-element naming papers whose elements are covered by stronger treatments already in the set (mcslock91, herlihyshavit, drepperfutex+kernelsyncdoc, grayreuter, kleppmannddia); their names remain as Phase-1 named_in provenance. Seeds rejected: Michael Hazard Pointers 2004 and Michael & Scott queue 1996 (no r5 element needs them - hazard pointers / lock-free queue are not in this route file); Lamport bakery and Treiber stack likewise not demanded. herlihyshavit entered as 2nd ed. 2020 (1st ed. 2008 is the Phase-1 naming edition). kernelsyncdoc scopes locking/, RCU/, and memory-barriers.txt as one living official-doc; all three sections loaded live.
